snippet.title: Pokémon Masters EX | Pokémon Day 2026 Celebration
snippet.description:
Pokémon Masters EX will hold a double anniversary celebration to commemorate 30 years of Pokémon and 6.5 years of Pokémon Masters EX!

Three exciting sync pairs are arriving soon in Pokémon Masters EX, bringing back classic favorites and showcasing recently discovered Legendary Pokémon:
 ➡️ Red (1996) & Pikachu - Friday, February 27, 2026, at 6:20 a.m. PST to Sunday, April 12, 2026, at 10:59 p.m. PDT.
➡️ Florian (Anniversary 2026) & Ogerpon - Friday, February 27, 2026, at 10:00 p.m. PST to Wednesday, April 8, 2026, at 10:59 p.m. PDT.
➡️ Juliana (Anniversary 2026) & Terapagos - Sunday, March 1, 2026, at 10:00 p.m. PST to Wednesday, April 8, 2026, at 10:59 p.m. PDT.

Find all your favorite Pokémon merchandise at the official Pokémon Center: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
